error: The specimen could not be loaded.
webglUnavailable: 3D viewing is unavailable in this browser.
instructions: Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Select a marker, an anatomical part, or a named anatomy button to learn more. Press Escape in the viewer to close a note.
studyMissing: Field study unavailable: the approved English recording and its complete timing data have not been supplied.
studyData: Field study unavailable: the recording configuration or timing data is invalid.
studyTargets: Field study unavailable: required armor or tail-club targets are missing.
studyCalibration: Field study unavailable: the specimen could not be calibrated for the {length} m scale comparison.
studyScaleUnavailable: Field study unavailable: no specimen length has been configured for scale comparison.
studyReady: Start the narrated field study. Pause to explore and inspect.
studyPaused: Narration paused. Explore or inspect, then resume.
studyBuffering: Narration is buffering. Progress is held.
studyBlocked: Playback was blocked. Select Play to continue, or Exit.
studyMediaError: Narration could not be loaded or played. Retry reloads the same recording at the retained position and remains paused.
studyTimingError: The recording duration or timing data does not match. Correct the recording configuration before retrying.
studyLeaving: Narration stopped. Changing language… Exit to Explore if navigation is interrupted.
studyHandoffInvalid: This study link could not be restored. You can explore or start a new study.
overviewDescription: Meet Ankylosaurus and Stegosaurus. Choose a specimen, discover its story, and open its interactive exhibit.
collectionIntro: Two remarkable plant-eaters. Two very different worlds.
chooseSpecimen: Choose a specimen to take a closer look.
posterUnavailable: Specimen image unavailable. You can still open the exhibit.
overviewFooter: Observe closely. There is more to every specimen.
previewInstructions: Drag horizontally to rotate; swipe vertically to scroll the page. You can also use the rotation and Reset buttons. Open the exhibit for anatomy and study.
previewError: The 3D preview could not be loaded. The image and exhibit remain available. Retry loads this specimen again.
previewUnavailable: 3D viewing is unavailable or the graphics context was lost. The image and exhibit remain available. You can retry.
tryDiscoveryAgain: Try a different name or remove filters to see more specimens.
